senses.gloss:
1. भी भी, ii. 3; i. 1, ved. (and † i. 10?), Par. (ved., and in epic poetry also Ātm., Chr. 292, 8 = Rigv. i. 85, 8; MBh. 3, 16289).
 1. To fear, Rām. 1, 59, 2. []
 2. To be afraid of, with abl., Man. 4, 191; with gen., Rām. 1, 1, 4; with acc., Lass. 51, 7. Anomal. aor. sing.
 2. भैस्, Chr. 36, 16.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. भीत, Frightened, Pañc. i. d. 364; fearful, Chr. 19, 14; timid, Chr. 54, 11; afraid of, Cāṇ. 96 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 413. n. Fear.
 --Comp.
 --Caus.
 1. भायय.
 2. भापय, Ātm.
 3. भीषय, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 1, 185), To terrify, MBh. 8, 1791. भिषित, Terrified, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 15.
 --With the prep. निस् निस्, निर्भित, adj. fearless, Rām. 2, 27, 17 (rather भीत, n. Fear, with निस्).
 --With प्र प्र, To fear in a high degree, Bhaṭṭ. 6, 2. (वि वि, in वि-भीत, adj. Fearless, is compounded rather with भीत).
 --Cf. ϕέβομαι, ϕόβος (ϕεβ = भाप् in the Caus. भापय), and probably ϕάψ; O.H.G. bibên; A.S. bifian, beofian (old frequent.).

2. भी भी, f. Fear, Pañc. i. d. 125.
 --Comp.
